signature_info.description: Microsoft Virtual Fibre Channel HBA miniport Driver

attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (native) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a legitimate Windows kernel-mode driver, specifically the Microsoft Hyper-V Virtual Fiber Channel Miniport driver (fcvsc.sys). It utilizes the Windows StorPort and VMBus (VmbChannel) APIs to facilitate virtualized storage communication between a guest VM and a Hyper-V host. Key behaviors include handling SCSI Request Blocks (SRBs), managing Host Bus Adapter (HBA) attributes via WMI, and establishing communication channels over the VMBus. The presence of functions like Request_MSFC_FCAdapterHBAAttributes and strings referring to 'Virtual Fibre Channel HBA' confirm its identity as a standard system component. No malicious indicators or suspicious logic were identified.
